neighbours.label: the slot just before a comparison word (is | similar, is | akin, very much | like); the + pole's output suppresses similar/akin/comparable, so this pole promotes them
fire: In structure, the triad color scheme is quite similar to the split scheme.
Its texture, being soft and porous, is akin to that of a sponge.
The second version is very much like the first, with minor changes.
The taste of the fruit is comparable to a mild pear.
This kind of rock is analogous to granite in its hardness.
The local dialect is closely related to the one spoken in the north.
The new building is reminiscent of a nineteenth-century railway station.
In shape, the leaf is similar to that of an oak.
quiet: In structure, the triad color scheme uses three evenly spaced hues.
Its texture, being soft and porous, absorbs water very quickly.

The taste of the fruit is sweet with a slightly sour finish.
